verdict.rationale: Docs mention that Marlin is pay-per-use on top of Pro/Team/Enterprise plans, that add-on credits cost ¥98 each, and that canceling mid-run still consumes credits, giving a researcher some sense of cost mechanics. However, there is no concrete base plan pricing table, no explicit usage caps (e.g., number of runs/credits per plan), and no worked cost examples for a typical 8-hour research run. missing for 10: full plan price list, explicit usage/credit limits per tier, cost estimation examples for typical runs.
